When supplied, the compiled model is checked before use: weights, model.mil and
analytics/coremldata.bin against fixed raw SHA-256; coremldata.bin against
six fixed SHA-256 values for the six possible orderings of its three metadata
entries (Debug and Release differ); metadata.json against a fixed SHA-256 of
Foundation JSONSerialization sorted-key encoding. These byte-order differences
carry identical metadata values across the verified iOS and simulator builds.
The original private build used a conversion utility not distributed here.
Torch, torchaudio, coremltools and ONNX Runtime were conversion/validation tools
only; no model or conversion output is included in this source release. The iOS App uses Apple's Core ML and Accelerate; no third-party inference
runtime, sound recording, embedding or test score is transmitted by this feature.
See CAMPlus-LICENSE.txt for the upstream license.
